title: Legally embattled AI music startup Suno raises at $2.45B valuation on $200M revenue (TechCrunch)
notes: TechCrunch, Julie Bort, 2025-11-19. $250M Series C @ $2.45B post-money; Menlo Ventures lead; NVentures, Hallwood Media, Lightspeed, Matrix. $200M annual revenue. Prior $125M Series B (May 2024) @ ~$500M. Sued by Sony/UMG/WMG. Corroborates 150.
